When you truly understand the love of God, and get full of His love, then the peace and joy that comes upon you, is something that can not be compared with anything else in this world. It is a peace and contentment that makes everything else in the world become unimportant, as all that matters is pleasing God, and knowing that His love will carry you through everything that the devil (John 10:10) and this world can throw at you. It is truly beyond explanation. If you have been born again, you have God’s love and peace in your new spirit, as it is a fruit of the Spirit (Galatians 5:22-23). Thank you Lord for giving us your love to share with others.
